name: nlp_distil_bert_bad
title: BERT -> student distillation with a softmax before CrossEntropyLoss, no zero_grad, no student.eval(), the warmup schedule stepped per epoch and the tensor loss accumulated
origin: hardening round 2, domain-nlp, 2026-09-14 - the defective twin of nlp_distil_bert
note: Nine planted defects, all nine modelled by a rule, five found today. The four misses are each a measured hole with a repro: MLV301 is silenced because a DIFFERENT model in the same call chain (the teacher) calls .eval() (NLP2-02); MLV205 cannot type a loss produced by a workspace nn.Module criterion (NLP2-09); MLV207 has no knowledge-table entry for transformers.get_linear_schedule_with_warmup even though its own cadence set names it (NLP2-08); MLV305's silence is declared by an untagged_dataflow diagnostic.

expected.defect: torch.softmax is applied to the student logits before they reach nn.CrossEntropyLoss
expected.why: CrossEntropyLoss log-softmaxes its input, so the hard term is a log-softmax of a softmax: the gradients are squashed and the student learns almost nothing from the labels

expected.defect: the batch loop never calls optimizer.zero_grad()
expected.why: gradients accumulate across every batch of the epoch, so the effective learning rate grows without bound and the run diverges

expected.defect: the epoch loss accumulates the tensor rather than loss.item()
expected.why: every batch's autograd graph - two BERT forwards deep - stays alive for the whole epoch

expected.defect: get_linear_schedule_with_warmup is stepped once per epoch instead of once per batch
expected.why: the schedule is built for len(train_loader) * epochs steps and receives three, so warmup never finishes and the run trains at a fraction of the intended learning rate

expected.defect: evaluate() never calls student.eval() - only the teacher is put in eval mode, on line 75
expected.why: the student is a BERT with dropout in every block, so every validation macro-F1 printed is measured through a randomly thinned network and the best checkpoint is chosen on noise

expected.defect: evaluate() is not wrapped in torch.no_grad() and carries no decorator
expected.why: the validation pass builds a full graph per batch and discards it

expected.defect: the predictions list holds raw logits (line 63) rather than logits.argmax(dim=-1)
expected.why: f1_score is handed a float matrix where it expects class ids, so the reported macro-F1 is meaningless
predictions come back in a different order every epoch, so no per-example comparison between epochs is possible

expected.defect: the correct twin's seed_everything() has been deleted
expected.why: the dropout masks, the shuffling and the head initialisation all move between runs, so the F1 difference between two distillation settings is not measurable

expected.defect: the whole module is pickled instead of student.state_dict()
expected.why: the checkpoint carries the class path, so it cannot be loaded by a project that moved the file

forbidden.why: optimizer.step() is called on line 51 - the defect here is the missing zero_grad, not a missing step
loss.backward() (line 49) is before optimizer.step() (line 51), which is the correct order
there is no torch.no_grad() block anywhere in this project - that absence is MLV302's finding
clip_grad_norm_ (line 50) sits between backward (49) and step (51), which is correct
no sigmoid and no BCE loss appear in this project
neither DataLoader takes num_workers=, and main() is reachable only from the __main__ guard (line 95)
every batch goes through move(batch, device) (lines 44 and 60) before the forward
no split call exists in this project; the encoded DatasetDict arrives already split
both nn.Module subclasses call super().__init__() (lines 17 and 37)
every submodule is assigned directly to an attribute; no plain list or dict of modules exists
there is no HuggingFace Trainer here - the loop is hand-written
there is no Keras code in this project

unsupported.defect: none - the optimizer is built over the student's own parameters and the student is never re-wrapped
unsupported.why: MLV211 is a later-tier rule and is not built

unsupported.defect: the teacher's forward (losses.py:45) has no torch.no_grad() and requires_grad is never turned off on its parameters, so the teacher's graph is built and back-propagated through on every batch
unsupported.why: MLV302 models a no_grad-less *evaluation region*, and the teacher forward sits inside a training step, so no rule covers a frozen model whose gradients are still computed

unsupported.defect: the best checkpoint is saved but never reloaded before the function returns, so the value returned describes a model the caller does not have
unsupported.why: MLV802's not_restored variant is a later-tier rule and is not built
